name: blockbench-mcp-pro
description: 最完善的 Blockbench MCP —— 插件内进程 HTTP(S) MCP + stdio 网关双通道

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix packages/plugin run build && npm --prefix gateway run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/shared run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/plugin run typecheck && npm --prefix gateway run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix packages/shared run test && npm --prefix packages/plugin run test && npm --prefix gateway run test
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
